rules.statement: In a test project, every async helper, including private test-local wrappers, takes a trailing CancellationToken and forwards it to the helper it calls instead of passing CancellationToken.None internally; call sites pass CancellationToken.None.
rules.why: A wrapper that hard-codes CancellationToken.None breaks the recorded async helper shape and stops callers from passing a token; the maintainer confirmed private wrappers are not exempt.
rules.check: Look for test helper methods returning Task or ValueTask that have no trailing CancellationToken parameter, or that pass CancellationToken.None to the helper they call.

rules.statement: In a test project, await an async call into a named local and assert on that local instead of awaiting inside an assertion's arguments (such as Assert.NotNull(await ...)); awaits inside lambda arguments, such as those passed to Assert.ThrowsAsync, may stay inline.
rules.why: Nesting a call inside another call's arguments breaks the no-nested-calls rule and makes multi-line assertions harder to read.
rules.check: Look for Assert.* calls whose direct arguments contain an `await` expression that is not inside a lambda.
